verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a developer API quickstart, where you create a personal access token and make a first API request that adds a page to the workspace. That is a guided API onboarding, not a walkthrough for setting up a workspace the first time. Nothing in the pack documents a first-run, in-product workspace setup guide.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
